material_findings.subject: Protected raw-stream storage, access, encryption, and deletion
material_findings.finding: The design separates redacted repository artifacts from a protected raw spool, but it does not choose a precise protected-store threat model, encryption/key authority, access procedure, retention boundary, or deletion/cryptographic-erasure model.
material_findings.required_resolution: Specify a repository-safe protected-stream storage and lifecycle contract, including explicit authorities, threat model, access controls, retention, legal-hold/tombstone behavior, deletion/erasure semantics, and fail-closed behavior.

material_findings.subject: Executable receipt grammar, vocabulary, canonicalization, and storage interface
material_findings.finding: The JSONL event model and parser rules are narrative. No versioned executable grammar, complete terminal-label vocabulary, canonicalization test vectors, or independently reviewable durable-storage interface is sealed.
material_findings.required_resolution: Specify versioned executable grammar and vocabulary artifacts, canonicalization vectors, parser error behavior, and a bounded durable-storage interface suitable for independent review.

material_findings.subject: Privacy-safe reproducible environment and interpreter identity
material_findings.finding: The design requires an allowlisted environment-name-to-digest map and interpreter metadata, but leaves exact fields, normalization, identity-digest procedure, redaction boundaries, and reproducibility/leakage cases open.
material_findings.required_resolution: Specify a field-level environment allowlist, normalization and redaction rules, executable/interpreter identity-digest procedure, and held-out privacy-leakage and reproducibility cases.
